_doc: Stage 1 trigger phrases for the oil desk's streaming headlines (services/intel/headline_watch.match_headline(..., triggers=True)). Operator, 2026-11-14. Case-insensitive whole-phrase matches; plural s allowed. Applied only to a provider stream whose query already narrows to oil/geopolitics (sources/finlight.py), never to the broad RSS feeds: a bare 'sanctions' or 'refinery' in a Google News wrap is routine (live smoke 2026-11-05), inside the Finlight oil query it is the event.
